scope: E-017 ReleaseManifestV2, DEV_LITE staged resources, local synthetic object, preflight, immutable bundle and rollback evidence

T-E017-MANIFEST-001.selector: strict ReleaseManifestV2 DEV_LITE and topology transition cases
assertions: ReleaseManifestV2 accepts only the closed DEV_LITE synthetic topology while historical V1 remains valid
V1 and V2 or STANDARD and DEV_LITE cannot share ordinary deploy, reconcile or rollback state
Production, STAGING, real identity and external object claims reject the local synthetic topology

T-E017-PREFLIGHT-001.selector: conditional standard DEV and DEV_LITE host and secret preflight cases
assertions: standard DEV still requires four CPU and seven GiB while DEV_LITE requires two CPU, 1.5 GiB, twenty GiB free and one GiB swap
DEV_LITE accepts only eight database and fault secrets and never creates COS config or credentials
public protected ports, wrong owner, time, runtime, swap, disk or topology fail closed

T-E017-COMPOSE-001.selector: DEV_LITE core budget, mutually exclusive workload windows and local object isolation cases
assertions: steady core memory limits total at most 704 MiB and stateful or TLS ports remain loopback-only
Admin, Interactive, Background, Restricted and one-shot profiles are mutually selected by the controller
local object smoke has network none, no secret, volume or host port and cannot enter standard or production overlays

T-E017-LOCAL-OBJECT-001.selector: one-shot in-memory object semantics and negative boundary cases
assertions: a bounded synthetic object completes PUT, GET, SHA-256, DELETE and HEAD 404 before the loopback server closes
unknown method, path, query, range, redirect, traversal and oversized body fail without retaining content
output omits object body, path and UUID and never claims external provider evidence

T-E017-BUNDLE-001.selector: DEV bundle V3, profile-bound release identity and historical V2 verification cases
assertions: V3 contains the DEV_LITE overlay and immutable evidence while historical V2 remains verifiable
deployment profile and built-in object fingerprint are bound into the release identity
the server receives no source tree, mutable image, object credential or production secret

T-E017-DEPLOY-001.selector: staged DEV_LITE deployment, cleanup, recovery, reconcile and rollback cases
assertions: pull and migration run in maintenance with core application stopped and bounded command timeouts
each non-core workload starts alone with a deterministic one-shot identity, completes its proof and is stopped on success or failure
the Admin window proves loopback TLS before closing while failed pull keeps stateful dependencies available for recovery
fresh deploy, reconcile, N plus one, rollback and redeploy preserve exact operation and receipt semantics

T-E017-RUNTIME-001.selector: post-phase OOM, restart, disk and protected-port evidence cases
assertions: every DEV_LITE phase fails before its receipt when the expected healthy service set drifts or any container is OOM-killed, paused, restarting or has restarted
phase-specific service sets enforce at most one expected transient workload and reject unknown Compose services
every DEV_LITE phase preserves at least twenty GiB free disk and no non-loopback protected listener
runtime diagnostics expose only phase and aggregate status without container IDs, paths, content or secrets
